about: Travel overlay on top of game.json (game.json is never edited). Owner rule 2026-10-06: far places are reached through their transport hub. Dúbravka 2020 is reached by bus from the Čierna Voda bus stop (S07) instead of the direct car transition from the street S02. The map shows regions first; fast travel is free inside a region, another region only through its hub. Schema: src/LastBell.Core/README.md section 13; decisions: docs/DECISIONS.md 'Control changes' item 7, design-doc/ISSUES.md TRAVEL-01. Texts and keys come from the C1 writing draft (docs/writing/out_v2/C1_ext.json 'travel').
